newsitem.title: USA: Encore Wire stake held by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Encore Wire stake held by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by Boston investor Jeffrey Vinik said Thursday it holds a 5.2 percent stake in Encorce Wire Corp or 367,500 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought its stake between December 30, 1996 and January 20, 1997 at prices ranging from $17.1250 to $20 per share.The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
The McKinney, Texas-based company is a low-cost manufacturer of copper electrical wire for commercial, industrial and residential use.
